'''''Portrait of the Emperor''''' was a [[Painting/Legends|painting]] that depicted the [[Galactic Emperor/Legends|Galactic Emperor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]]. The painting depicts him smiling sadistically as he "holds" two [[Planet/Legends|planets]] and a [[Moon/Legends|moon]] on his left hand, with his index finger discharging [[Force lightning/Legends|Force lightning]] on the [[Color/Legends|orange]] planet.

{{Stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
The painting was given out, alongside ''[[A Rebel Painting]]'', to players who attended the 2006 SWG Fanfest, with players having to choose between the two. Since ''Star Wars Galaxy''{{'s}} 10th Game Update, it alongside ''A Rebel Painting'' have been declared to be shared no trade items.
